stem:
Meena ties a stone to a thread to make a simple pendulum for her science project at home. She pulls the stone to one side and lets it swing freely.
Which of these describes one complete oscillation of the pendulum?

options.text: The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position.
The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position and returns to the mean position.
The stone moves from one extreme position to the other extreme position and returns to the starting extreme position.
The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position, then to the other extreme position, and back to the mean position.

teacher.key_rationale: One complete oscillation requires the bob to start at the mean position, reach one extreme, swing to the opposite extreme, and return to the mean position, completing one full repeat of the path. Options A and B cover only partial swings, and option C, while a valid count starting from an extreme, is the distractor here; D states the full definition expected at grade 7.
